claim.property: API key is sent only in the fixed HTTPS provider header; changed lifecycle diagnostics and receipts do not echo the credential, CDP endpoint or hostile response body.
claim.attacker: untrusted network/page content without provider TLS identity; operator and Cloud provider already have key authority

assets: remote browser session with possible profile cookies
session recording and provider session ID

principals.name: local operator/daemon
principals.existing_authority: sets and reads its own process environment and cloud credential

principals.name: Browser Use API
principals.existing_authority: authorized recipient of API key, creates remote browser and stores requested profile/recording

principals.name: browser page
principals.existing_authority: controls its own content, no changed path to provider environment

principals.name: network peer
principals.existing_authority: can fail or delay transport; lacks accepted API TLS certificate

boundaries: daemon HTTPS to fixed Browser Use API host
entrypoints: HTTPS response body containing id and cdpUrl
sinks: API-key header to fixed HTTPS API endpoint
CDP attachment without forwarding the API header

prerequisites: operator configures Browser Use API key

chain.capability: provider responses may contain unexpected or secret-shaped text
chain.reachability: response fields enter local diagnostics and receipt creation
chain.control: ID parsed as UUID; reflected credential UUID rejected; response bodies and raw CDP errors omitted
chain.boundary: returned text and local receipt cannot inherit API-key/CDP credential content through the changed error paths
chain.impact: reduces accidental disclosure without demonstrating a new attacker authority crossing

evidence: providers.rs browser_use_client disables redirects and retains TLS validation; safe constant receipt body
actions.rs attach_provider_cdp replaces raw connector errors

verification.authorized_scope: isolated localhost fixtures with dummy key and read-only source review; no third-party account access
commands: cargo test --manifest-path cli/Cargo.toml -- --test-threads=1; seven reversible production mutations; built CLI dogfood/continuity/idle proofs
verification.cleanup: Temporary fixture sockets/Chrome processes cleaned up; no live credential in artifacts.
limits: Changed-boundary source/fixture review only; no hosted penetration test, ACL confidentiality or power-loss durability assertion.
